description: This file is an ES Module JavaScript script used for testing the build process of a plugin system in the OpenClaw project. It sets up test environment, loads plugin modules, performs assertions to verify correct plugin loading and command handling, and manages cleanup routines.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Sets up a custom process warning filter to ignore specific warnings related to 'punycode'.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes plugin commands and deletes temporary directories created during testing.
